Use the [Testing hub](https://group5-vitail-project.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/G5VA/pages/13795332) for plans, case definitions and run records. Keep prior author runs separate from new integration runs; a passing test suite is not a claim that every acceptance criterion passed.

Apply the [feature, review and release standard](https://group5-vitail-project.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/G5VA/pages/43515905). Record the actual non-author review and any accepted exception; do not invent client sign-off.
